title: feat(runtime,client,cli): export a deployment's whole ontology as installable packages in one read (GET /packages/export, os package export)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-warren"} -->
_Requested by **Warren** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8?thread=cmsg_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8HPBiw3dHprSTrka5xiidsK)_
Fixes #28914

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:运行时新开 `GET /api/v1/packages/export`,一次导出整个部署的本体:所有不是由部署自身代码注册的已安装包(市场安装的、库里创作的,含 `.custom` 配对包,停用的也算),每一项就是现有单包导出 `GET /packages/:id/export` 的原样回答,按依赖顺序排(基础包在前)。配套 SDK 方法 `client.packages.exportAll()` 和 CLI 命令 `os package export [--out DIR]`(每个包写一个带序号的目录,可直接 `os package install`);spec 去掉 `[PLANNED — not yet served]` 标记。
- 为什么改:官网承诺「本体是你的,可以导出到开源运行时跑」,今天只能一个包一个包导;spec 形状已由 #29100 落地,阻塞的 #29617(导出带 namespace / dependencies)已由 #29651 落地,本 PR 是最后的服务端切片。
- 风险与回滚:纯新增路由和命令,不改任何现有接口的回答;读门与单包导出相同(`studio.access` / `setup.access`)。回滚即撤回本 PR。
- 先看:`packages/runtime/src/domains/packages.ts` 的 `assemblePackageExportBundle` 与新路由分支(在 `GET /packages/:id` 之前);`packages/cli/src/commands/package/export.ts`;`packages/spec/src/api/package-lifecycle.zod.ts` 的 docblock 与 describe(去标记的公开面)。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime exec vitest run src/domains/packages-export-bundle.test.ts`,预期 10 条全绿(选包、依赖序、单一生产者、读门、查询参数拒绝、整体或不答)。
- 需要你做的:无,席位做完契约复审后落地。

## What changes

- **Runtime (`packages/runtime/src/domains/packages.ts`).** A new branch answers `GET /packages/export`, matched ahead of `GET /packages/:id` (`export` is never a package id: `MANIFEST_ID_PATTERN` needs two dot-separated segments). It asks the per-package export's read gate first (`requireReadCapability`: `studio.access` or `setup.access`, or a system context), then refuses any query parameter `400 VALIDATION_ERROR` naming it (`unknownQueryParamRefusalMessage(query, [])`, the same closed-set refusal `GET /packages/:id/customizations` uses). `assemblePackageExportBundle` then:
  - selects every registry row whose `source` is not `code`, disabled rows included, each id once (the row's `source`, never `manifest.scope` or `writable`, as `PackageExportBundleSchema` states);
  - orders them with the boot's own sorter, `orderHydrationBatch` from `@objectstack/core` (ADR-0141 D5), over `declaredDependencyIds(row.manifest)`, so a `.custom` pair follows its base whatever order the registry lists them in;
  - composes each entry with `assemblePackageManifest`, the per-package export's producer, and nothing else: no second clean or redaction rule;
  - is whole or absent: a thrown assembly answers through `errorFromThrown` (its status kept) with the message prefixed `The export of package 'ID' could not be assembled, so no bundle is answered:`; a `null` assembly answers 500 naming the package.
- **Mount (`packages/runtime/src/dispatcher-plugin.ts`).** `mountPackagesRoute('get', '/export', …)`, registered before `/:id` so the literal segment wins.
- **Route ledger (`packages/runtime/src/route-ledger.ts`).** Row `GET /packages/export` → `packages.exportAll`, `responseSchema: 'PackageExportBundleSchema'`; the census sentence regenerated (116 → 117) by `check-route-ledger-census.mjs --fix`.
- **Client (`packages/client/src/index.ts`).** `client.packages.exportAll()`, answering a `PackageExportBundle`; its row in `unwrap-misfire.pin.test.ts`'s roster (`PackageExportBundleSchema` declares `packages` only, so the `success`+`data` heuristic cannot fire).
- **CLI (`packages/cli/src/commands/package/export.ts`, exported from `src/index.ts`).** `os package export [--out DIR] [--url] [--token]`, through `createApiClient` like the `os meta` commands. It writes `DIR/NN-ID/objectstack.json`, one per entry, numbered in the order served (zero-padded so a listing sorts in install order), and prints the `os package install` commands in that order. Loud and never partial: a refusal prints with status and code and writes nothing; an entry with no id is refused naming its position; an `--out` directory that already holds files is refused before the read; an empty bundle writes nothing and says why.
- **Spec (`packages/spec/src/api/package-lifecycle.zod.ts`).** The `[PLANNED — not yet served]` marker comes off `PackageExportBundleSchema`'s describe, which now names the route and `os package export`; the docblock's "MUST do / not served today" prose now states what the door does. No key, type or accept set changes. The test that pinned the marker is flipped (no `PLANNED`, names the route and the command, no tracker id); the regenerated `content/docs/references/api/package-lifecycle.mdx` follows (`check:generated --fix`).
- **Docs.** `content/docs/deployment/cli.mdx`: a row in the package command table and an `os package export` section (what is and is not exported, the numbered install order, no secret, no enabled state, whole or nothing, who can export, options). `content/docs/concepts/metadata-lifecycle.mdx`: the export paragraph now names the whole-deployment read beside the per-package one.
- **Changeset** `.changeset/28914-package-export-whole-deployment.md`: runtime, client, cli, spec all `patch` (kind `none`, a non-protocol widening per AGENTS.md's level rule).

## Why

The card's server slice: the maintainer's ruling on docs.objectos.ai #334 (record 6568804196) approved building the whole-ontology export; the spec slice (#29100) declared the answer and the blocker #29617 (#29651) made each per-package export carry what a reinstall reads. This PR serves the read and the command and meets the card's two Done tests.

## Tests

- **Door pins** (new `packages/runtime/src/domains/packages-export-bundle.test.ts`, real dispatcher over a registry and protocol double, 10 tests): selection (`code` excluded, disabled included, each once, parses as `PackageExportBundleSchema`); dependency order with the registry listing both dependents ahead of the base (control asserted); each entry `toEqual` the `GET /packages/:id/export` answer for the same id; empty when every row is `code`; the read gate (`studio.access` and `setup.access` admitted, `manage_metadata` alone 403 with the registry and protocol never read); `?format=zip` → 400 `VALIDATION_ERROR` naming `format`, registry never read; whole or absent twice (no protocol → 500 naming the first package; a throw on the second package's assembly → its 503, message naming that package, no `data`); `export` never reaches `getPackage`; the ledger row.
- **CLI pins** (new `packages/cli/test/package-export.test.ts`, the real command and the real `ObjectStackClient`, only `createApiClient` stubbed, 6 tests): numbered directories with each entry as served and the install commands in order; **each written file is the `manifest` the real `os package install FILE` posts, unchanged** (install driven per file, its POST captured); a 503 refusal printed with status and code, exit 1, nothing written; a non-empty `--out` refused before any request; an empty bundle writes nothing; an id-less entry refused naming its position.
- **Round trip and credential** (new `packages/qa/dogfood/test/package-export-bundle-round-trip.dogfood.test.ts`, two real showcase boots with install-local mounted, 5 tests). Source: a base installed through install-local (object, app, dashboard, flow, permission set, and a connector with `auth: { type: 'bearer', credentialRef }`), its `.custom` pair with a published dashboard override, and a third package depending on the base and extending its object. The bundle is exactly those three ids (the showcase's own `code` package absent), the base first, the pair carrying `namespace` `exportbase_custom`, its base edge and its override; the connector carries its `credentialRef` and the secret the reference resolves to on the source (control: set in the process env) appears nowhere in the response bytes. Target: each entry installs 200 through `POST /marketplace/install-local` with `{ manifest: entry }` (the body `os package install FILE` sends), in the order served, and the target's own bundle answers the same ids in the same order with the same namespace, dependencies and per-collection item names and counts; the pair's override comes back with its `overrides` block.
- **Client**: `packages-lifecycle.test.ts` pins `exportAll` → `GET /api/v1/packages/export` and the order served.
- **Spec**: the flipped marker test.

<details><summary>Ablation (one-time, runtime tests resolve packages.ts from source; scripts/ablation-replace.mjs)</summary>

On `699399a4`, fix committed first:

- `orderHydrationBatch(nodes).ordered` → `nodes.map((n) => n.item)`: `Tests 2 failed | 8 passed (10)` (dependency order; and the null-protocol case, which names the first package and so reads the order).
- `row?.source === 'code'` → `row?.source === 'never'`: `Tests 2 failed | 8 passed (10)` (selection; empty bundle).
- Both restored: `blob after restore == blob at HEAD (8a46b0cd25ab)`, `git diff HEAD` empty.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- **The door's status on a failed assembly.** The declaration says only "fails the read, naming that package". A thrown assembly keeps the status `errorFromThrown` resolves for it; a `null` one (no metadata protocol) answers 500. No new error code.
- **`Clause-②: yes (a new served route)`** from the claim is written here as `yes (widening)`: AGENTS.md's closed arm set is `(widening)` / `(narrowing)`, and a new route that changes no existing answer is a widening. `Metadata-protocol: none`: nothing a metadata author writes changes.
- **No new spec key**, and the spec diff is describe text and docblock only; the marker drop is the published-schema face the seat's contract review reads.
- `assemblePackageManifest` swallows a per-type read error as "type unsupported here" (`continue`), as before; the bundle inherits that. Not changed here.
- docs.objectos.ai #334's "export your ontology" page is the docs lane's follow-up, as the card says.
